# Compatibility Fixtures

These files are immutable test inputs: every 1.x reader must load them (D-172, D-187). Add a fixture when a release adds a package section or a save version, and keep every earlier one. The fixtures from before 1.0 were retired with their readers (D-174); git history keeps them.

- `format-1.bespoke` is the script `format-1-package.bspk` was compiled from: a yard with a judge, a thief, a clerk, and a lamp; inline art with two looks, a sprite, and an area; a display name and a phrase; two axes, one with `drift step 4`; a dilemma with `tiers 8 and 4`, `drift cap 3`, and a drift line; a goal whose need has a tier 4 hint under `limit hints 4`; a `when each` rule; `save version 2`; `rewinds reroll`; and `clock: turns` (P48-17, P48-22).
- `format-1-package.bspk` is package format 1 (`BSP1`), with the sections `NAME`, `PLAC`, `CODE`, `RULE`, `GOAL`, `AXIS`, `DLMA`, `IMGS`, `ARTB`, and `TEXT`. Written by BeSpoke Engine 0.4.0, before the 1.0 tag, on 2026-11-25 with `bespoke compile` (regenerated for `P48-23`: sorted `CODE` maps and `script_owned` relation flags bit).
- `format-1-save-dice.sav` is save version 1 (`BSV1`): the `DICE_SCRIPT` in `src/host.zig` (a gambler who throws 1d100 each tick), started with seed 7 and saved after three ticks with its world, walking agent, fiber, and dice, and the description `P48-14 compatibility fixture` (D-184). Written by BeSpoke Engine 0.4.0 on 2026-11-25 through the Zig API (regenerated for `P48-23`: 32-byte little-endian `SnapshotHeader`, `script_owned` relation flags bit, and canonical `reactive_rules` order).
- `format-1-save-each.sav` is save version 1 (`BSV1`): the `EACH_SCRIPT` in `src/host.zig` after Ada takes the sword, so its `when each` rule holds her row, with the description `P48-16 compatibility fixture` (D-186). Written by BeSpoke Engine 0.4.0 on 2026-11-25 through the Zig API (regenerated for `P48-23`).
- `format-1-cycles.bespoke` and `format-1-cycles.bspk` add the optional `CYCL` section: one palette colour cycle of three colours every 8 display frames (P49-01, D-190). Written on 2026-11-26, before the 1.1.0 tag, with `bespoke compile`.
- `format-1-exits.bespoke` and `format-1-exits.bspk` add the required `EXIT` section: two scenes whose room blocks place their marks and lead to each other through one exit each (P47-11, D-199). Written by BeSpoke Engine 1.2.0 on 2026-11-28 with `bespoke compile`.
